claims: Olivia Munn was diagnosed with stage 1 luminal B bilateral breast cancer in April 2023.
Olivia Munn had a normal mammogram two months prior to her diagnosis.
Olivia Munn had negative genetic testing prior to her diagnosis.
Olivia Munn had no family history of breast cancer.
Olivia Munn's OB/GYN used the Tyrer-Cuzick Risk Assessment Calculator.
Olivia Munn's OB/GYN determined she had a 37% chance of developing breast cancer.
Olivia Munn underwent four surgeries over 10 months.
Olivia Munn underwent a double mastectomy.
Olivia Munn underwent a lymph node dissection.
Olivia Munn underwent a nipple delay procedure.
Olivia Munn underwent an oophorectomy to stop cancer-feeding hormones.
Following her diagnosis, Olivia Munn's mother Kim tested positive for breast cancer.
Olivia Munn is taking hormone suppression therapy to prevent recurrence.
Prevent Cancer Foundation notes Olivia Munn's story caused a massive surge in people using online risk assessment tools.
Olivia Munn has become a vocal advocate for women to ask their doctors to calculate their Breast Cancer Risk Assessment Tool (.gov) score.
